attchmntText: EID Parry India Limited has informed regarding Sale / Disposal of Sivagangai Distillery Unit
voiceSummary: EID Parry Limited announced the Board of Directors approval on November 13, 2026, for the slump sale of its Sivagangai Distillery Unit to M/s. SVRAJU Agro Private Limited. The proposed sale consideration is Rs. 45,90,00,000, subject to due diligence and conditions precedent. The transaction is not a related party transaction. The unit generated income of Rs. 119.58 crore in the financial year ended March 31, 2026, representing approximately 3% of total company income. The company's investment in the unit stood at approximately Rs. 9.84 crore as at March 31, 2026. The Business Transfer Agreement is expected to be executed within 30 days, with completion anticipated within three months. The buyer was incorporated on September 29, 2026. This action is part of the company's asset rationalisation strategy.

attchmntText: EID Parry India Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: E.I.D. Parry India Limited announced the approval of its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a loss after tax of Rs. 2,249 lakhs, compared to a loss of Rs. 8,929 lakhs in the same period last year. Revenue from operations stood at Rs. 86,001 lakhs. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, the loss after tax was Rs. 11,178 lakhs, compared to a profit of Rs. 13,354 lakhs in the previous year. Revenue from operations for the six-month period was Rs. 1,59,313 lakhs. The limited review report by Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP indicated no material misstatements. Investor presentations and detailed results are available on the company website and stock exchange platforms.
